name: Run hill sprints 40
description: Ten short, steep, fast sprints with full recoveries: hill power and running economy. Stop a rep early if form breaks. Needs the console in running mode and --running-mode.

ramp.name: Warm-up
ramp.notes: Easy jog or brisk walk, relaxed shoulders.

steps.name: Hill sprint
steps.notes: RPE 9 for 30 s. Drive hard, stay tall.

ramp.name: Cooldown
ramp.notes: Walk it off; let the breathing settle.
